item.title: TOWN OF CARROLLTON AWARDED GRANT FOR RECYCLED TIRE PICNIC TABLES
item.description: (from left) Tom Ward, Carrollton mayor Keith Higgins, Bryan Mathis, Michael Link, and Hayden Fry stand among the 39 picnic tables the Town of Carrollton was able to purchase with a grant from the Missouri Department of Natural Resources. Not pictured were Parks Superintendent Lance Croy and Doug White. (Photo courtesy of Keith Higgins)
